title: Open Sangam Verse
description: Canonical schema (v2) for one record in the Open Sangam corpus: a whole poem (anthology verse, keyed by `number`) or one section of a long idyll (keyed by `sectionNumber` with `lineStart`/`lineEnd`). Structure: record → lines[] → words[]. Validated in CI by backend/python/tests/test_corpus_schema.py; run `python -m normalizer.validate_corpus` for a report.

id.description: Unique record id `<poem>_<number>`, zero-padded as on disk, e.g. 'kurunthokai_001' or 'maduraikanchi_006'. Must equal the file name.

number.description: Verse number within an anthology (Kuṟuntokai 1–401 etc.).

sectionNumber.description: Section number within a long idyll (Pattuppāṭṭu).

lineStart.description: First line of this section in the whole poem's line numbering.

lineEnd.description: Last line of this section in the whole poem's line numbering. lineEnd − lineStart + 1 should equal lines.length; known source gaps are listed in data/schema/known_line_gaps.json.

heading.description: One-line heading shown in the reader (Tamil).

poet.description: Poet named in the colophon, in Tamil script; null when unattributed.

sangamTamil.description: Original verse text in Sangam Tamil script

urai.description: Modern Tamil prose rendering (Urai). Null until AI-generated and verified.

yazhi_urai.description: Plain, colloquial modern Tamil paraphrase (Yazhi Urai) — an easier-to-read retelling than the more formal `urai` prose. Null until AI-generated.

yazhi_uraiMeta.description: Provenance for an AI-drafted yazhi_urai field, written by backend/python/ai/translate_with_gemini.py. Same shape as englishMeta.

english.description: Contemporary English translation. Null until AI-generated and verified.

englishMeta.description: Provenance for an AI-drafted english field, written by backend/python/ai/translate_with_gemini.py. Absent for verses translated by hand.

promptVersion.description: Prompt revision that produced the draft, e.g. 'english-v1'

etymologyMeta.description: Provenance for AI-drafted word-level glossary fields (root/urichol/etymology/gloss), written by backend/python/ai/extract_etymology.py. Absent until a run has annotated this verse's words.

promptVersion.description: Prompt revision that produced the draft, e.g. 'etymology-v1'

wordsAnnotated.description: Word count covered by this run, for a quick sanity check against lines[].words

lineNumber.description: 1-based position of the line inside this record (not the whole-poem line number; for idyll sections add lineStart − 1).

form.description: Word as it appears in the verse

etymology.description: Detailed explanation IN TAMIL — derivation, cognates, morphology, and semantic shift to modern usage

gloss.description: Detailed English gloss — the word's meaning and how it functions in this verse, not just a 1-4 word tag

culturalNotes.description: Cultural context annotations linked to spans in the verse

audioUrl.description: URL to an audio recording of the verse recitation

source.description: URL or citation of the original text this record was taken from (provenance; required).

verified.description: True only after scholar sign-off. While false, every AI-drafted field (urai/yazhi_urai/english/word glosses) is a draft and the reader must label it as such.
